questions.stem: The electric current in the circuit is given as $i = i_{0}(t/T)$. The r.m.s current for the period $t = 0$ to $t = T$ is________.

Assuming in forward bias condition there is a voltage drop of $0.7\ \mathrm{V}$ across a silicon diode, the current through diode $D_{1}$ in the circuit is __________ mA. (Assume all diodes in the given circuit are identical)

For the two cells having same EMF E and internal resistance r, the current passing through the external resistor $6\ \Omega$ is same when both the cells are connected either in parallel or in series. The value of internal resistance r is ___________ $\Omega$.
questions.solution:
In series, $i_{1} = \frac{2E}{6 + 2r}$
In parallel, $i_{2} = \frac{E}{6 + \frac{r}{2}}$
$i_{1} = i_{2} \Rightarrow \frac{2E}{6 + 2r} = \frac{E}{6 + \frac{r}{2}}$
$12 + r = 6 + 2r$
$r = 6\ \Omega$

questions.stem:
Water drops fall from a tap on the floor, 5 m below, at regular intervals of time, the first drop strikes the floor when the sixth drop begins to fall. The height at which the fourth drop will be from ground, at the instant when the first drop strikes the ground is ___________m.
$(g = 10\ \mathrm{m/s^{2}})$
questions.solution:
Time to reach ground $= \sqrt{\frac{2h}{g}} = \sqrt{\frac{2 \times 5}{10}} = 1\ \mathrm{sec}$
Five drops per second
Time between each drop = 0.2 sec.
Time of fall for $4^{th}$ drop is $1 - 0.6 = 0.4$ sec
Height fall of $4^{th}$ drop is $= \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 0.4^{2} = 0.8\ \mathrm{m}$
Height from ground $= 5 - 0.8 = 4.2\ \mathrm{m}$

The ratio of the Young's modulus of A to that of B is $x : 3$. The value of x is ________.

A block of mass 5 kg is moving on an inclined plane which makes an angle of $30^\circ$ with the horizontal. Friction coefficient between the block and inclined plane surface is $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$. The force to be applied on the block so that the block will move down without acceleration is ___________N. $(g = 10\ \mathrm{m/s^{2}})$
questions.solution:
$mg\sin 30^\circ = F + \mu mg\cos 30^\circ$
$F = 5 \times 10 \times \frac{1}{2} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times 5 \times 10 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$
$F = 25 - \frac{75}{2} = 25 - 37.5$
$F = -12.5\ \mathrm{N}$
$\therefore$ force will be downward on incline of magnitude 12.5 N

questions.stem: An atom ${}^{8}_{3}X$ is bombarded by shower of fundamental particles and in 10 s this atom absorbed 10 electrons, 10 protons and 9 neutrons. The percentage growth in the surface area of the nucleons is recorded by :
questions.solution:
Surface area $x \propto A^{2/3}$
$X_{i} = 8^{2/3}K = 4K$
$X_{f} = (8 + 10 + 9)^{2/3}K = 9K$
% increase in surface area of nucleus
$x_{i} = \frac{9K - 4K}{4K} \times 100 = 125\%$

questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I : A plane wave after passing through prism remains as plane wave but passing through small pin hole may become spherical wave.
Statement II : The curvature of a spherical wave emerging from a slit will increase for increasing slit width.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution: Increasing the slit width 'a' decreases the diffraction angle $(\theta = \lambda/a)$ and reduces the spreading of the wave. A narrower slit produces a more pronounced spherical wave (high curvature) while a wider slit leads to a flatter, less curved wave.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true

questions.stem: In the following p-V diagram the equation of state along the curved path is given by $(V - 2)^{2} = 4ap$ where a is a constant. The total work done in the closed path is :
questions.solution:
w = Area of parabola
$= \frac{2}{3}$(Area of rectangle AC31A)
$= \frac{2}{3}P_{0}(3 - 1) = \frac{4P_{0}}{3}$
When $V = 1$
$(1 - 2)^{2} = 4aP_{0}$
$P_{0} = \frac{1}{4a}$
$w = \frac{4}{3}P_{0} = \frac{4}{3}\frac{1}{4a} = \frac{1}{3a}$
$w_{gas} = \frac{-1}{3a}$

10 kg of ice at $-10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is added to 100 kg of water to lower its temperature from $25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Consider no heat exchange to surroundings. The decrement to the temperature of water is _______ $^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
(specific heat of ice = $2100\ \mathrm{J/kg.^\circ C}$, specific heat of water = $4200\ \mathrm{J/kg.^\circ C}$, latent heat of fusion of ice = $3.36 \times 10^{5}\ \mathrm{J/kg}$)

In the potentiometer, when the cell in the secondary circuit is shunted with $4\ \Omega$ resistance, the balance is obtained at the length 120 cm of wire. Now when the same cell is shunted with $12\ \Omega$ resistance, the balance is shifted to a length of 180 cm . The internal resistance of cell is _________$\Omega$.
questions.solution:
Let E is emf and r is internal resistance of cell.
$\frac{E \cdot 4}{r + 4} = 120K$
$\frac{E \cdot 12}{r + 12} = 180K$
$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{3}\frac{r + 12}{r + 4} = \frac{2}{3}$
$r + 12 = 2(r + 4)$
$\Rightarrow r = 4$
